name: comfyui-chenxin
description: Local-first ComfyUI plugin: prompt-forge prompt authoring plus three fixed-workflow camera skills (image, multiview, video) consumed through a unified local MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Prompt authoring plus three fixed-workflow camera skills for local ComfyUI.
interface.longDescription: Four bounded skills: prompt-forge authors and quality-reviews image/video prompts offline; camera-image, camera-multiview, and camera-video consume approved PromptPackages through a unified local ComfyUI/MCP four-stage production flow against fixed release assets.
defaultPrompt: Use prompt-forge to author a prompt.
Use camera-image, camera-multiview, or camera-video to produce.
